# cpanel_ssl_csr (Resource)

Generates and manages one public certificate signing request stored by cPanel from an existing key ID. Terraform reads only the signed public PKCS#10 request and metadata; it never reads, creates, uploads, changes, or deletes private keys. Import requires country, state or province, locality, organization, and every inventory domain in the DNS SAN extension because those immutable values must satisfy the resource schema.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_ssl_csr" "example" {
  key_id                   = "existing-cpanel-ssl-key-id"
  friendly_name            = "Terraform example CSR"
  domains                  = ["example.com", "www.example.com"]
  country_name             = "FR"
  state_or_province_name   = "Ile-de-France"
  locality_name            = "Paris"
  organization_name        = "Example Organization"
  organizational_unit_name = "Platform"
  email_address            = "admin@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `country_name` (String) The two-letter uppercase country code. Changing it replaces the CSR.
- `domains` (List of String) The ordered domain list for the CSR. The first value becomes the common name and all values become DNS names. Changing the list replaces the CSR.
- `friendly_name` (String) The display name stored by cPanel for the CSR. This is the only mutable CSR field.
- `locality_name` (String) The certificate subject city or locality. Changing it replaces the CSR.
- `organization_name` (String) The certificate subject organization. Changing it replaces the CSR.
- `state_or_province_name` (String) The certificate subject state or province. Changing it replaces the CSR.

### Optional

- `email_address` (String) The optional certificate subject email address. Changing it replaces the CSR.
- `key_id` (String) The existing cPanel SSL key identifier used to generate the CSR. It is required when creating a CSR and is intentionally unavailable after import because cPanel does not expose the originating key ID. Changing it replaces the CSR.
- `organizational_unit_name` (String) The optional certificate subject organizational unit. Changing it replaces the CSR.

### Read-Only

- `common_name` (String) The CSR common name.
- `created` (Number) The CSR creation time reported by cPanel as a Unix timestamp.
- `csr` (String) The canonical PEM-encoded public PKCS#10 certificate signing request.
- `ecdsa_curve_name` (String) The ECDSA curve name reported by cPanel, when applicable.
- `ecdsa_public` (String) The ECDSA public point reported by cPanel, when applicable.
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String) The lowercase SHA-256 fingerprint of the PKCS#10 DER bytes. Rename and deletion operations require this exact ownership fingerprint.
- `id` (String) The CSR identifier assigned by cPanel.
- `key_algorithm` (String) The CSR public-key algorithm reported by cPanel.
- `modulus` (String) The RSA public modulus reported by cPanel, when applicable.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_ssl_csr.example csr-id-from-cpanel
```
